title: Terrible and useless.
body: You can only upload TikRot and Instagram recipes, links from regular recipe sites aren’t allowed. You can only add a few recipes and it wants you to pay. Such a shame since the concept is perfect. I deleted after five minutes. The ratings are clearly faked because there is only one text review that’s negative, but 77 5 star reviews with nothing to back them up. This app seems like a scam to get your data.

title: App begs for your money
body: You can only add a few recipes on the free version. This app is just a cash grab and there are so many better apps out there.
